ignoreValues.reason: Body face only; the display face is Lexend, which the rule does not flag. Inter is the incumbent body font across all 49 pages of this app, self-hosted as a variable latin subset, and it was chosen for its tabular figures: ratings render at numeric(5,3) and the rankings tables, score columns and rating deltas all depend on figures that do not shift width when a digit changes. Swapping it is a system-wide change to data legibility, not a landing-page typography choice, and this session's scope was one surface. Not user-confirmed.
